title_en: An Empty Cart Returns: The Record

commands.text: The cart reaches the open gate with no burden to deliver. Tovin keeps both hands on the handle.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: We do not know how many were taken to the pit. We write that plainly.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: And we stop calling it storage.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: Will saying it change what is under there?

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: It changes what the next person is told. That is what we can promise.
On the yard map, Mera strikes one word through once. The mark remains readable.
